facts.statement: The species of the genus Tiaraspis is named subtilis.
The species Tiaraspis subtilis was described by Gross in 1933.
The genus Tiaraspis was established by Gross in 1962.
Fossils of Tiaraspis subtilis have been found in Germany dating from the Pragian to the Emsian epochs of the Early Devonian.
facts.quote: Its fossils are found from Early Devonian Germany, ranging from the Pragian epoch until the Emsian.

facts.statement: Tiaraspis belongs to the class Placodermi.
Tiaraspis is classified within the family Holonematidae.
Tiaraspis lived between 419.62 and 393.47 million years ago, spanning the Lochkovian to Emsian stages.
facts.quote: Time range: Lochkovian to Emsian (419.62 to 393.47 million years ago)

rejected.statement: Tiaraspis subtilis is the oldest known member of the arthrodire placoderm family Groenlandaspidae.
rejected.quote: Tiaraspis subtilis is the oldest known member of the arthrodire placoderm family Groenlandaspidae.
rejected.reason: statement copies the source wording: 'is the oldest known member of the arthrodire'
